questionSummaryShownToOwner: #80: first fetch of documents from the nine pilot towns (fetch only). 40 registered sources (council information systems, participation portals, official gazettes, town websites); Hagenow council excluded (login); three BOB-SH entries inventory check only. Per source one round, 4-24 documents, 6-28 requests; at most 630 fetch attempts in total, about 200-490 documents expected. Honest user agent with contact; at most one request per host at a time, at least 5 s apart; robots override of 11 Oct applies; login/403/captcha/paywall stops that source; third-party works excluded; opt-out/deletion honoured; facts with source attribution only, originals private. Lead starts runs one after another and monitors; ntfy after each town; about 4-10 hours; valid until Sun 25 Oct. No AI models and no publication. Fetched sets become usable for processing only if every document passed the checks; hashes reported to the owner. A = approve as described, B = half the limits, C = not yet.
